old_text: Only the optimized Lupranol-based LPO-1 rigid PUR formulation characterized in this study. Lupranol 3300/3422 polyether polyols and polymeric MDI distinguish this formulation; it is not the suberin-based SPO series despite the article title. LPO-1 is a study formulation, not a certified product grade. Do not count LPO-2/LPO-3 as extra identities or substitute modeled target/normalization densities.
new_text: Selected optimized rigid PUR formulations: LPO-1, LPO-2, SPO-2 and SPO-3, with apparent-density results from Table 10. LPO-1/LPO-2 have Lupranol 3300/3422 input ratios 40/60 and 66/34 g; SPO-2/SPO-3 have SA-C_TOFA(50:50)/TMP and SA-E_ETOFA(50:50)/TMP input ratios 67/33 and 40/60 g. These study formulations are not certified product grades or final cured-network compositions. LPO-3 and SPO-1 remain outside the current native selection; preserve the Table 10 versus section 3.4 SPO-1 density-range discrepancy. Do not substitute modeled target density, compression-normalization density or conditions/counts from other tests for the selected apparent densities.
scope: Curatorial scope correction; no independent scientific approval
